items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The clothing and jewellery are also excluded as personal property and as property kept in a vehicle away from the insured location (§§4.3(d), 4.3(f), and 4.5).
The car is not insured property under §4.3(e), and §5.2.5 expressly excludes vehicle-related expenses. No amount is payable.
